caveat: Correct level of granularity. Resist making it more specific without a worm assay.

term: GO:0120516 sn-1-specific diacylglycerol lipase activity / EC 3.1.1.116
current: UniProt recommended name + 6 RHEA statements, all ECO:0000256 ARBA
lead_action: DO NOT PROPAGATE; flag as over-annotation
basis: Every statement is automatic propagation from contested human data (E11). PMID:27544863 found no DAG hydrolysis by purified human ABHD11 (E8) and PMID:32579589 disagrees (E9). 39.6% identity is below the range for transferring substrate specificity.
caveat: This is a UniProt name and EC, not a GO IEA in GO Central; the curation action is to avoid importing it.

basis: Human IDA (PMID:32792488). Would be the most informative term if it transfers.
caveat: Complex membership is the least safely transferable class of annotation across 39.6% identity. Needs a worm co-IP or lipoylation assay first.

basis: Rests entirely on the contested DAG lipase assignment. The best-supported human process is lipoyl-cofactor maintenance on OGDHc, which is not lipid metabolism in the usual sense.
caveat: Removing it leaves the gene with no BP term; curator may prefer to retain with a note.

basis: Equivalent presequence to abhd-11.2: net charge +4, moment 0.402, MPP R-2 at 12 (E5). No evidence for a different compartment.
Triad complete (Ser114-His267-Asp140), Ser OG to His NE2 2.93 A, oxyanion hole intact (E1). Not a pseudoenzyme.
caveat: 7 diagnostic pocket substitutions including Phe to Arg at 5.1 A from the nucleophile (E2) predict a different substrate preference, which GO:0052689 does not assert either way.

basis: abhd-11.1 is the SF3 copy, Caenorhabditis-restricted, 32.5% identity to human, no protein-level evidence, 3.1x lower expression (E6, E7).
caveat: Any human-orthology transfer should go to abhd-11.2 only.

term: redundancy statement in the gene review
lead_action: STATE AS SUBFUNCTIONALISED, not redundant and not pseudoenzyme
basis: Both triads complete (E1), both under strong purifying selection at omega 0.08 and 0.07 (E3), both mitochondrially targeted (E5), but 7 fixed pocket differences (E2) and a 3.1x expression gap with reproductive bias in abhd-11.1 (E6).
caveat: Subfunctionalisation is inferred from sequence and expression. No worm double-mutant or substrate assay exists (E13).
